faq.q: How often should a chimney be maintained?
faq.p-2: For most wood-burning chimneys, once a year — ideally before the season. After seeing yours we’ll recommend an honest schedule; sometimes that means less often.
faq.q-2: What does a maintenance visit include?
faq.p-3: A sweep and a check: flue, damper, cap, crown, flashing and moisture signs — with photos you can compare year over year.
faq.q-3: When is the best time to book?
faq.p-4: Late summer and early fall, before the first cold snap fills the calendar. Spring works too — problems found then are cheapest to fix.
faq.q-4: Do you service rentals and multi-unit properties?
faq.p-5: Yes. Leave the property details and we’ll sort scheduling and access with you or your tenants.
faq.p-6: Catching a hairline crown crack costs a fraction of rebuilding a water-damaged stack. Maintenance is how chimneys stay boring — in the good way.
